During the [[Jedi Civil War]], '''archives''' were located in [[Garang]], [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]]. Crime and transaction records were archived, and could later be retrieved by [[Analysis droid/Legends|information droids]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a report was filed by the [[Garang municipal authorities|municipal authorities]] about a fight between two colonists named [[Calder Nettic]] and [[Rickard Lusoff]]. The archive also contained a report that showed Nettic and a [[Gender/Legends|man]] named [[Handon Guld]] had rented a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] together several times. This information was later retrieved by a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] during an investigation into Nettic's death carried out by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bolook]] and [[Amnesia/Legends|amnesiac]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
